description: What a task's variable is bound to: value, and what else its type has. Picked from what its host offers (task_choices), or typed in as any text.

value.description: What it is: a model's value, a decision model's URL, a host's id or name, a context's, pod's, container's or database's name, or the text.

label.description: What it's shown as (a model's name, a host's), if not its value.

host.description: A model's: the member of the mesh that serves it, by name (its provider), if it isn't this host.

model.description: A decision model's: the model its endpoint is asked for.

container.description: A database's: the container it runs in.
